tools.name: get_article
tools.description: One DiarioBitcoin article by id or slug (from get_news; never a URL). Returns the get_news fields plus body as plain text. body_kind="excerpt" means the full text is not offered for this article: summarize from the excerpt and link to url, or buy the full text with get_full_article if you can pay. tools.description: PAID: the full text of one DiarioBitcoin article, for a few cents in USDC or USDT on Solana mainnet, paid per call with x402 (no account or API key). Same arguments as get_article. tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Search or list DiarioBitcoin articles (Spanish-language crypto news, 2014-today). With query: best matches first (relevance, boosted by recency); every word must match; write queries in Spanish ("regulación", not "regulation"; accents optional; tickers and names like BTC, ETF, BlackRock as-is). tools.name: get_usage_guide
tools.description: How to use this server well: recipes (today's news on a topic, latest news, topic research, paging), what each result field means, the paid-placement labels, how to cite, and what to do on each error code. Markdown. Call it once before a non-trivial task; the same text is the resource dbtc://guide.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List DiarioBitcoin's news categories: id, slug, name (Spanish), count of published articles, parent id (0 = top level) and paid_placement ("sponsored_article", "press_release" or null for editorial categories). Use a slug as get_news's category. Synced from the site hourly; as_of is the sync time.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_article" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
